{{Quote|You know, my brother-in-law is the constable of this planet. He might like a word with you."''<br />''"Oh, yeah? Well, I don't think your brother is really the constable of the planet!|[[Dremullar Obohn di Garthos]] and [[Marn Hierogryph]]|<ref name="LP" />}}
The '''brother-in-law''' of [[Dremullar Obohn di Garthos]], both members of the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was the [[Constable/Legends|constable]] of the<ref name="LP" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. At some point in [[Gender/Legends|his]] life, di Garthos's brother [[Marriage/Legends|married]] his Muun [[Dremullar Obohn di Garthos's brother-in-law's bride|consort]] and held a wedding party with the entire [[Ralltiiri police force]]. The curators of the [[Obohn Gallery of the Industrial Aesthetic]], di Garthos and a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] called "[[Father (Rodian)|Father]]," had a [[Hologram/Legends|holo-recording]] of the wedding. When [[black marketeer]] [[Marn Hierogryph]] and accomplice [[Zayne Carrick]] tried to fence [[statuary]] artwork to the Obohn Gallery during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], di Garthos doubted the legitimacy of the duo and threatened to summon for his brother-in-law to arrest them, producing the holo-recording to back up his threat.<ref name="LP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The only appearance of di Garthos's brother-in-law has been in the short story ''[[Labor Pains]]'' ([[2008]]) by [[John Jackson Miller]], in which he was mentioned by di Garthos as well as appearing in a hologram.
